_comment: The servers drifterd runs (drifterd.py): code in <live>\<dir>, runtime files in <data>\<module> ({data}), output in <data>\logs\<module>.console.log; the gateway keeps config.json, certs and logs in its own folder (runtime_in_code). command runs in the module folder with DRIFTER_DATA set; data_args are appended. health = a cheap GET on 127.0.0.1 (shown on the System page; it never stops or restarts anything), none = only the port is checked. requires = files that must exist before a start (MasterVolt's certificate script would create a new CA without them). precheck = asked of the module before a restart or switch-off (drifter.py make_precheck).
